message:
Partial refunds now come out at the right amount, and `npm test` passes (20 of 20).

`partialRefund` in `src/payments/partial-refund.js` treats `percent` as 0–100, but it multiplied the amount by `percent` without dividing by 100. That made a 50% refund of 1250 come out as 62,500 instead of 625. I added the `/ 100`. I changed nothing outside `src/payments`.
